name: com.gatrends/trend-radar
title: GAtrends trend radar
description: Free trend radar for games and tech: what is spiking now in Steam, news, Reddit, Wikipedia.

tools.name: get_trend_signals
tools.description: Public GAtrends radar for games and big tech. Returns the latest signals from the last 24 hours: spikes in Steam players, news coverage and Wikipedia views for the tracked topics, new topics found in headlines, trending Google searches, new Steam entries, Hacker News stories and new GitHub repositories, with the headlines and links behind each one. Use it to find what just became popular. Read-only, no account needed.

topic.description: Only signals mentioning this game or topic, for example GTA 6, CS2 or OpenAI.

limit.description: How many signals to return (1-8). Default 8.

tools.name: get_topic_status
tools.description: Current figures for the topics on the public GAtrends radar (Steam players online, news articles in 3 hours, Wikipedia views per day) and whether each is above its usual level. Read-only, no account needed.

topic.description: Game or topic name. Without it, returns all public topics.
